rationale: The agent correctly verified the user by matching full name and ZIP to a single account, reviewed order details, identified the delivered order containing the requested items, obtained explicit confirmation before initiating returns, and executed the return using the correct item IDs and original payment method. However, earlier the agent misstated the number of t-shirt options “available right now” as 12, despite tool data showing 2 variants were unavailable (leaving 10 available). This constitutes providing incorrect information unsupported by the tools. Given the pass bar requires correct final information for all user requests, the overall outcome fails despite the properly handled return process.
